title: Structure à l'infini des Mg,ν [pages 1 à 90, dont table des matières] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

errors: In (268) the dimension-1 GLOBAL factors indexed by I'_1 are labelled 'facteurs D^*'. By (264) and by the next page (the soul is C^{*I'_1} × P^{I'_0}) they should be C^* factors. This is a slip of the pen.

The role of the D factors (I''_0) in the codimension count is not explained. The next page sets the codimension d'_0 = card I'_0, counting only the P factors. Whether a germ-of-disc factor contributes to the 'stratum' or only to its normal data is left implicit at this stage.

The expectation that the elementary types are exactly the products, and that the inclusions are generated factorwise, is stated as an expectation ('On s'attend à'), not proved. For topoi, products of germ-topoi and the compatibility of gluing with products require justification that is not given here.

ideas.what: Reconstruct C (with divisor at 0) as the amalgam C^* ⊔_{D^*} D of the open part and a disc germ along the punctured disc germ; extend to C^I by taking I-fold products of the four-term diagram.
ideas.modern_name: Homotopy-pushout / cubical decomposition of a normal-crossings pair; recollement (Artin gluing) of topoi; stratified homotopy type built from deleted tubular neighbourhoods
ideas.usually_credited_to: Recollement: SGA4 (Artin–Grothendieck–Verdier). Stratified gluing of links: Thom–Mather, later MacPherson and Lurie/Treumann (exit-path categories). Kato–Nakayama real blow-up, 1999.
ideas.where_published: Recollement of topoi is in SGA4. The 'structure at infinity' and tubular neighbourhoods of the boundary of M_{g,ν} are mentioned programmatically in Esquisse d'un programme.

ideas.what: Classification of the elementary local types of (C^n, coordinate divisor) by maps I → {C^*, P, D, D^*}, i.e. generalized partitions with possibly empty classes, organised as global/local × dim 0/dim 1.
ideas.modern_name: Indexing poset of strata with tubular / deleted-tubular data; faces of a cube product of a 4-object diagram
ideas.usually_credited_to: Folklore in stratified topology and log geometry

ideas.what: Notion of the 'soul' (âme) of an elementary topos: the global stratum C^{*I'_1} × P^{I'_0}, with codimension = card of the P-factors (anticipated on this page, made explicit on the next).
ideas.modern_name: Underlying stratum / base of a tubular-neighbourhood topos

missed.claim: Grothendieck sets up a systematic 'elementary topos' calculus for normal-crossings boundaries: 4^n types indexed by generalized partitions, with inclusions generated factorwise. It is meant as a building block for the topos or homotopy type 'at infinity' of M_{g,ν}. The general gluing formalism along the Deligne–Mumford boundary is not worked out on this page. Modern analogues (Kato–Nakayama spaces, exit-path ∞-categories, tangential base points in Ihara–Nakamura) cover this ground, but not in this explicit four-type product formalism.
missed.quote: On s'attend à ce que les "types élémentaires" qui correspondent à cette situation soient les produits (indexés par I) de types de l'un quelc. des quatre types envisagés dans (264)
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This gives a concrete combinatorial presentation of the profinite or étale homotopy type near the boundary of M_{g,n}. That is relevant to the Grothendieck–Teichmüller tower and tangential base points, but the construction itself is now standard.

deep.surprise_reason: This is a clean but essentially standard local combinatorics of normal-crossings divisors: a product of a four-term gluing diagram. Its interest is mainly historical, as part of Grothendieck's unpublished programme on the structure at infinity of M_{g,ν}. It contains no result absent from the later literature.
transcription_corrections: 'de types de l'ens. préc. des quatre types' should read 'de types de l'un quelc[onque] des quatre types'.
'correspond aux facteurs du type "gl. 5.2"' should read 'du type "global"' (the handwriting 'glob.l').
'des emplissements indexés dans le diagramme (265)': 'indexés' is likely 'indiqués'. The word 'emplissements' is uncertain; it may be 'plongements' or 'remplissements'.
The marginal note is: '"partitions" au sens généralisé : il peut y avoir des "classes" vides'. It replaces the struck words 'Cela nous amène à' and attaches to 'considérons les partitions possibles'.
In (268) the image labels I'_1 as 'facteurs D^* (de dim 1)'. This is faithful to the manuscript, but is presumably a slip for C^*.
